name: The Attack!
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Tyrion and Elling Trias draw a traitor into a garden meeting. Their plan aims to catch conspirators working against the kingdom.

sections.title: A Garden Ambush
sections.body: Tyrion, the spy, and Elling Trias, a cheese merchant, bring their investigation to a head inside Stormwind Keep. Tyrion has told Marzon that he and Lord Gregor Lescovar should meet again, and fed him false information. Then Tyrion sends an engineered automaton disguised as Priestess Tyriona into the library to tell Lescovar that his guest has arrived. Lescovar sends his guards away and enters the quiet garden to meet Marzon the Silent Blade, an assassin tied to the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: Treason in the Keep
sections.body: Hidden nearby, investigators hear Lescovar and Marzon confirm their suspicion: Stormwind nobles are aiding the Defias conspiracy against the kingdom. When their treasonous talk ends, the trap springs. Lescovar and the Silent Blade must be killed quickly in the courtyard, before the royal guards return and find a noble dead on the cobblestones. The strike cuts away one of the Defias's deepest footholds in Stormwind's seat of power.

sections.title: Shadow Games
sections.body: Elling Trias takes satisfaction in settling his personal score with Marzon, though he resents that his private plans also help Mathias Shaw and SI:7. Lescovar's death proves corruption has reached the court. The Defias Brotherhood had help, and someone among the nobility let it grow.

faq.answer: Lord Gregor Lescovar is a prominent nobleman who lives in Stormwind Keep. He secretly worked with the Defias Brotherhood, using his rank and influence to undermine the realm from within the palace.

faq.q: Who is Marzon the Silent Blade?
faq.answer: Marzon the Silent Blade is an assassin for the Defias Brotherhood. He connects the outlaws with Lord Lescovar, carrying messages and plotting schemes until Tyrion draws him into the garden trap.

faq.q: Why does Elling Trias care about this operation?
faq.answer: Elling Trias is a cheese merchant and an influential rogue with ties to Stormwind's underworld. Marzon targeted people close to him, so Trias plotted the assassin's downfall, even though it also helped Mathias Shaw and SI:7.

faq.q: How does Tyrion manage to lure Lescovar outside?
faq.answer: Tyrion sends an engineered automaton disguised as Priestess Tyriona into the library to tell Lescovar his guest has arrived. Lescovar dismisses his guards and goes to the garden. Tyrion had already told Marzon to meet again and fed him false information.

faq.q: Why do the guards not immediately defend Lescovar?
faq.answer: Lescovar sends his guards away before the meeting to keep his dealings with the Defias secret. That leaves investigators a brief chance to ambush Lescovar and Marzon before the royal guards intervene.

faq.q: What happens after Lescovar is slain?
faq.answer: After Lescovar and Marzon die, Elling Trias sends you to Old Town to tell Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7 that the threat has been dealt with, in The Head of the Beast.

angles.text: As a rogue, you see how underworld dealings can reach into Stormwind's politics, even through a cheese shop and a quiet garden.
As an Alliance member, you see a Defias ally removed from Stormwind Keep, while the danger to the kingdom's leadership remains.
As a human of Stormwind, you learn that nobles within the royal palace secretly fuel the bandit crisis in Westfall and Redridge.
